title: The most expensive model 最昂贵的型号
description: Mr Frith and Mrs Frith go into an electrical shop to buy a television. The assistant shows them the most expensive model, but they cannot afford it. Mr Frith wants to buy the expensive one on installments, but Mrs Frith points out that they can't afford the price. The lesson covers comparatives and superlatives, and the grammar workbook section focuses on irregular comparatives, making sentences with comparatives, and using 'as...as' and 'not as...as'.
answer_note: Practice A (comprehension) is model answers (suggested). Practice B (vocabulary) is from the workbook answer key (source-key). Grammar I-IV are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, p.543-545).

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: I like this television very much. How much does it cost?
lines.translation: 我非常喜欢这台电视机。它多少钱？

lines.speaker: ASSISTANT
lines.text: It's the most expensive model in the shop. It costs five hundred pounds.
lines.translation: 这是店里最昂贵的型号。它要500英镑。

lines.speaker: MRS. FRITH
lines.text: That's too expensive for us. We can't afford all that money.
lines.translation: 这对我们来说太贵了。我们出不起那么多钱。

lines.speaker: ASSISTANT
lines.text: This model's less expensive than that one. It's only three hundred pounds. But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.
lines.translation: 这种型号的比那种要便宜些。它只要300英镑。但是，它当然没有价钱高的那种好。

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: I don't like this model. The other model's more expensive, but it's worth the money.
lines.translation: 我不喜欢这种型号。那种型号价格是贵一些，但它值这么多钱。

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: Can we buy it on installments?
lines.translation: 我们可以用分期付款的方式购买吗？

lines.speaker: ASSISTANT
lines.text: Of course. You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds, and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
lines.translation: 当然可以。您可以先付30英镑订金，然后每月14英镑，3年付清。

lines.speaker: MRS. FRITH
lines.text: I certainly do, but I don't like the price. You always want the best, but we can't afford it. Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!
lines.translation: 我当然喜欢，但是我不喜欢这个价钱。你总是要买最好的，可我们买不起。有时候你以为自己是个百万富翁！

lines.speaker: MR. FRITH
lines.text: Millionaires don't buy things on installments!
lines.translation: 百万富翁是不会用分期付款买东西的！

items.title: 1. 比较级和最高级的构成
items.text: 大多数两个以上音节的形容词可与 more/less 连用构成其比较级形式，与 most/least 连用构成其最高级形式。如本课中的几个例子：This model's less expensive than that one; The other model's more expensive.

items.title: 2. not as...as
items.text: 意思是，放在前面的人或物在程度上低于后面的（人或物）。it's not as good as the expensive one，可以用来进行比较。

items.title: 3. buy...on installments
items.text: 以分期付款的方式购买。

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 225 and answer these questions.
practice.translation: 看学生用书第225页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.context: Model answers based on the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Does Mr Frith like the television?
questions.answer: Yes, he does. (He likes it very much.)

questions.prompt: Is it the most expensive model in the shop — or the cheapest?
questions.answer: It's the most expensive model in the shop.

questions.prompt: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: (It costs) £500.

questions.prompt: Is it too expensive for the Friths?
questions.answer: Yes, it is.

questions.prompt: Can't they afford all that money?
questions.answer: No, they can't.

questions.prompt: The assistant shows them another one. Is it the same price as the first one?
questions.answer: No, it isn't. It's less expensive.

questions.prompt: Is it as good as the expensive one?
questions.answer: No, it isn't.

questions.prompt: Which television does Mr Frith really want to buy?
questions.answer: He really wants to buy the expensive one.

questions.prompt: Can they buy it on installments?
questions.answer: Yes, they can.

questions.prompt: How can they do that? What does the assistant explain?
questions.answer: They can pay a deposit of £30 and then £14 a month for three years.

questions.prompt: Does Mrs Frith like the television?
questions.answer: Yes, she does.

questions.prompt: But what doesn't she like?
questions.answer: She doesn't like the price.

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Read these sentences and write in the missing words. They are all from the dialogue.
practice.translation: 读以下句子，完成以下句子。它们都来自对话。
practice.context: Workbook L111 B: 1-5 vocabulary words from the dialogue.

questions.prompt: I can't spend so much money on a new suit. I can't ... it.
questions.answer: afford

questions.prompt: That man has more than £1 million. He is a ...
questions.answer: millionaire

questions.prompt: I'm going to pay the first £20 on a new bicycle. That's the ... of £5 a month. And then there are 36 ...
questions.answer: deposit, installments

questions.prompt: You've just bought a new dress. What was the ... of it? — Only £20.
questions.answer: price

questions.prompt: Charlotte bought a new cooker last week. She bought the latest ...
questions.answer: model

grammar.title: Grammar I: Put the adjectives in comparative or superlative form
grammar.instruction: 用所给形容词的比较级或最高级形式填空。
grammar.translation: 用所给形容词的比较级或最高级形式填空。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.543 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Adjectives: old, warm, warm, expensive, fast, bad, bad, good.

questions.prompt: Ann is ... (old) than Hans.
questions.answer: older

questions.prompt: Summer is ... (warm) than winter.
questions.answer: warmer

questions.prompt: Summer is the ... (warm) of the four seasons.
questions.answer: warmest

questions.prompt: These cars are the ... (expensive) in China.
questions.answer: most expensive

questions.prompt: An aeroplane is ... (fast) than a train, and a train is ... (fast) than a car, so an aeroplane is the ... (fast) of the three.
questions.answer: faster, faster, fastest

questions.prompt: This is the ... (bad) coffee I have ever tried.
questions.answer: worst

questions.prompt: You are no ... (bad) than I am at singing. I think I am the ... (bad) singer in the world!
questions.answer: worse, worst

questions.prompt: Your work is much ... (good) than it was last week.
questions.answer: better

grammar.title: Grammar II: Make sentences using the information given
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用所给的信息造句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的信息造句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.543-544 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Each item has two sentences (comparative + less form). Item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: That book is interesting but this book is very interesting.
questions.answer: This book is more interesting than that one. That book is less interesting than this one.

questions.prompt: This girl is beautiful but that girl is very beautiful.
questions.answer: That girl is more beautiful than this girl. This girl is less beautiful than that girl.

questions.prompt: That armchair is comfortable but this armchair is very comfortable.
questions.answer: This armchair is more comfortable than that one. That armchair is less comfortable than this one.

questions.prompt: The girl is careless but the boy is very careless.
questions.answer: The boy is more careless than the girl. The girl is less careless than the boy.

questions.prompt: The first question is difficult but the second question is very difficult.
questions.answer: The second question is more difficult than the first one. The first question is less difficult than the second one.

questions.prompt: My son is hard-working but my daughter is very hard-working.
questions.answer: My daughter is more hard-working than my son. My son is less hard-working than my daughter.

questions.prompt: That dress is expensive but this dress is very expensive.
questions.answer: This dress is more expensive than that one. That dress is less expensive than this one.

questions.prompt: This driver is careful but that driver is very careful.
questions.answer: That driver is more careful than this driver. This driver is less careful than that driver.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Make sentences using the information given
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用所给的信息造句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的信息造句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.544 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Superlative + least form. Items 1 and 2 are printed examples.

questions.prompt: the chair on the left / the chair in the middle (comfortable / of all)
questions.answer: The chair on the left is the most comfortable of all the chairs, and the chair in the middle is the least comfortable.

questions.prompt: this picture / that picture (beautiful / I've ever seen)
questions.answer: This picture is the most beautiful I've ever seen, and that picture is the least beautiful.

questions.prompt: your book / his book (interesting / I've ever read)
questions.answer: Your book is the most interesting I've ever read, and his book is the least interesting.

questions.prompt: this engineer / that engineer (hard-working / I've ever met)
questions.answer: This engineer is the most hard-working I've ever met, and that engineer is the least hard-working.

questions.prompt: this hairdresser / that hairdresser (careful / of all)
questions.answer: This hairdresser is the most careful of all, and that hairdresser is the least careful.

questions.prompt: the red car / the black car (expensive / I've ever seen)
questions.answer: The red car is the most expensive I've ever seen, and the black car is the least expensive.

questions.prompt: the French paper / the Maths paper (difficult / of all)
questions.answer: The French paper is the most difficult of all, and the Maths paper is the least difficult.

questions.prompt: this man / that man (important / of all)
questions.answer: This man is the most important of all, and that man is the least important.

grammar.title: Grammar IV: Make sentences using the cues given
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用所给的词造句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词造句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.544-545 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Comparative + not as...as form. Item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: our room / dirty / your room / not as clean
questions.answer: Our room is dirtier than your room. Our room is not as clean as your room.

questions.prompt: this watch / expensive / that watch / not as cheap
questions.answer: This watch is more expensive than that watch. This watch is not as cheap as that watch.

questions.prompt: his handwriting / bad / her handwriting / not as good
questions.answer: His handwriting is worse than her handwriting. His handwriting is not as good as her handwriting.

questions.prompt: a boat / slow / a car / not as fast
questions.answer: A boat is slower than a car. A boat is not as fast as a car.

questions.prompt: a cigar / big / a cigarette / not as small
questions.answer: A cigar is bigger than a cigarette. A cigar is not as small as a cigarette.

questions.prompt: this book / thin / that book / not as thick
questions.answer: This book is thinner than that book. This book is not as thick as that book.

questions.prompt: this question / difficult / that question / not as easy
questions.answer: This question is more difficult than that question. This question is not as easy as that question.

l111-scene.description: Mr Frith and Mrs Frith in an electrical shop looking at televisions with the assistant. Six panels showing the dialogue progression: the expensive £500 TV, the cheaper £300 TV, the hire purchase sign, and the final discussion.
